guarantees.claim: When fifo_empty_q is 1 and fifo_empty is 0, fifo_empty_negedge asserts to 1; otherwise it is 0.
When fifo_full_q is 0 and fifo_full is 1, fifo_full_posedge asserts to 1; otherwise it is 0.

fifo_full_seen_d is cleared to 0 when any of reg_hash_start, reg_hash_continue, reg_hash_process, reg_hash_stop is true; otherwise cleared on fifo_empty_negedge; set to 1 on fifo_full_posedge; otherwise holds the value of fifo_full_seen_q.
guarantees.cond: priority from command signals, then negedge, then posedge, then default

guarantees.claim: fifo_empty_gate is 1 when msg_allowed is 0 or fifo_full_seen_q is 0; otherwise it is 0.
When fifo_empty_gate is 1, status_fifo_empty is forced to 0; otherwise status_fifo_empty equals fifo_empty.

assumptions.claim: fifo_empty_q and fifo_full_q must hold the previous clock cycle values of fifo_empty and fifo_full, respectively, to enable glitch-free edge detection.
assumptions.risk: Stale or misaligned delayed versions cause incorrect fifo_empty_negedge / fifo_full_posedge, leading to wrong updates of fifo_full_seen_q and consequently wrong interrupt gating.

assumptions.claim: fifo_full_seen_q must be updated with fifo_full_seen_d on every relevant clock edge so that the tracking history remains valid.
assumptions.risk: If fifo_full_seen_q is not refreshed, the fifo_full_seen_d combinational logic is ignored, causing stale state and potential loss of full-to-empty transition detection.

assumptions.claim: msg_allowed must accurately flag when software is permitted to write the message FIFO; it must not be asserted spuriously and must deassert when writes are prohibited.
assumptions.cond: whenever the FIFO gate logic evaluates
assumptions.risk: A glitch or false msg_allowed=1 could expose an interrupt signal before the FIFO has been legitimately filled, while stuck-at-0 would permanently mask the fifo_empty interrupt.

assumptions.claim: reg_hash_start, reg_hash_continue, reg_hash_process, reg_hash_stop are single-cycle command pulses asserted at the appropriate message boundaries to reset the full-seen tracking.
assumptions.cond: at the beginning or end of a message
assumptions.risk: Spurious or mistimed assertion of these commands clears fifo_full_seen_q prematurely, causing the logic to miss a full condition and suppress a needed interrupt.

assumptions.claim: fifo_empty and fifo_full reflect the true instantaneous status of the hardware message FIFO.
assumptions.risk: Incorrect FIFO status flags cause spurious edge detections, potentially corrupting the full-seen history and the interrupt output.

uncertain_points.claim: If the FIFO never becomes full (fifo_full_seen_q stays 0), status_fifo_empty remains 0 even when fifo_empty=1, effectively suppressing the empty interrupt for short messages.
uncertain_points.cond: FIFO depth larger than message size, or message never fills FIFO
uncertain_points.risk: Software may hang waiting for an empty interrupt that will never fire, breaking protocol for small or fragmented messages.

uncertain_points.claim: fifo_empty_negedge and fifo_full_posedge are pure combinational edge detectors; glitches on fifo_empty/fifo_full while fifo_empty_q/fifo_full_q are updated in the same cycle could produce false pulses on fifo_full_seen_d.
uncertain_points.cond: when fifo_empty or fifo_full changes far from clock edge or when delay mismatches exist
uncertain_points.risk: A false pulse might set or clear fifo_full_seen_q erroneously if not filtered by the sequential update of fifo_full_seen_q.

uncertain_points.claim: The origin of msg_allowed is not visible; it may derive from software-programmable registers or security states that require additional sychronization or qualification.
uncertain_points.risk: If msg_allowed is misconfigured or deasserted too late/early, the interrupt gating could bypass a security check or cause a deadlock.
